observations.title: Operated greenhouse gases
observations.locator: Operated Basis, GHG rows; ACS p64
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: Published rounded components sum98 rather than97. Preserve reported total; source explicitly permits rounding. Do not force reconciliation or silently replace total. AR6 basis. Scope2 methods are alternatives.

observations.title: Operated sector emissions
observations.locator: Operated Basis segment rows; ACS p64
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: 36+39+22=97. Chemical and downstream burdens must not be divided by upstream production.

observations.title: Equity greenhouse gases
observations.unit: million metric tons CO2e except methane_mass in million metric tons CH4
observations.boundary: equity basis, distinct from operational control
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: 104+7=111;46+40+25=111. Equity and operated totals are alternative allocations, never additive. Public table does not supply asset ownership bridge.

observations.title: Operated methane mass
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: 142kt is approximate, not direct measurement of every emission. 0.14Mt is compatible rounding. GWP must be explicit for any modeled conversion; do not compare CH4 mass to CO2e without conversion.

observations.title: Upstream methane sources
observations.locator: Pie chart p39, visually checked; footnote8
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: Rounded shares sum101%, not100%. Approximate source pools are analytical ceilings; do not treat category shares as installed-equipment eligibility or feasible abatement.

observations.title: Hydrocarbon flaring
observations.unit: million standard cubic feet/day except flaring_ghg in million metric tons CO2e
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: Regional volumes sum150. Routine excludes safety/nonroutine. All-flaring GHG already inside Scope1 and includes overlapping methane. Cannot allocate5Mt by4/150 without composition and combustion-efficiency evidence.

observations.title: Energy input
observations.unit: use:billion GJ; intensities:GJ/metric ton production or throughput
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: 1.4 billion GJ=388.9TWh thermal-equivalent, not purchased electricity or electrifiable load. Mixed fuels, process heat, power and sectors require disaggregation.

observations.title: Net oil-equivalent output
observations.boundary: company net production, not gross operated production
observations.locator: MD&A Upstream Additional Information, Volumes Reconciliation
observations.assurance: Not covered by environmental assurance reviewed
observations.caveats: 4736*365/1000=1728.64. Natural gas conversion six million cubic feet per thousand barrels. Do not use as denominator for operated corporate emissions.

observations.title: Product-use emissions
observations.boundary: Category11 use of production; alternative refinery/sales accounting views
observations.locator: Scope3 estimates p66; table visually checked
observations.status: company modeled potential combustion estimate using EPA/API factors
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: 170+530=700. Alternatives must not be summed. Non-fuel products and other14 Scope3 categories excluded. This is not a complete lifecycle footprint. Ownership reconciliation of production basis not explicitly supplied in table. Direct operational improvements do not eliminate customer combustion at fixed fuel sales.

observations.title: Freshwater
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: Withdrawal and consumption overlap, not additive. Basin/month/source scarcity and quality data missing; global volumes cannot quantify local harm.

observations.title: Air and water releases
observations.boundary: operated assets; oil spills exclude marine vessels
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: Converted0.06/0.11/0.12Mt to tonnes;0.4kt=400t;6.0thousand barrels=6000. Pollutants differ in toxicity and exposure. No aggregation into CO2 or a score; do not add controlled discharges and spills without pathway reconciliation.

observations.title: Captured CO2
observations.locator: CO2 captured for storage row and footnote8; ACS p64/67
observations.assurance: 2025 assurance not established; company page says underway
observations.caveats: Includes geological storage, acid-gas injection and enhanced recovery applications. Not automatically permanent net avoidance or additional abatement. Do not subtract from reported emissions again.
